summary: Iteration 16: Tested CASCADE functionality for checklist execution changes. Found and fixed 3 bugs: (1) Action plans not created when existing finding updated, (2) generate-from-checklist not creating plans for existing findings, (3) findings_count including resolved findings. All 13 tests now pass.

bugs_fixed.issue: Action plans not auto-created when existing finding is updated (only when new finding created)
bugs_fixed.fix: Added check for existing action plan and create if missing when updating existing finding

bugs_fixed.issue: generate-from-checklist not creating action plans for existing findings without plans
bugs_fixed.fix: Added check for existing action plan and create if missing during sync

bugs_fixed.issue: findings_count in GET /api/audits/{audit_id} included resolved findings
bugs_fixed.fix: Changed to only count active findings (status != resolved_by_compliance)

critical_code_review_comments: Pre-existing lint warnings in server.py (unused variables, multiple statements on one line) - not related to cascade functionality
seed_data_creation: Used existing test audit aud_d44a6cb2. Tests create/update checklist items and findings during execution.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 16 verified and fixed the CASCADE functionality. When checklist item changes: (1) no_cumple creates NC finding + corrective action plan, (2) parcial creates observation finding + preventive action plan, (3) cumple/no_aplica resolves finding + closes action plan with closure_note. The generate-from-checklist endpoint now creates missing action plans for existing findings. findings_count now correctly excludes resolved findings.

implementation_details.cascade_flow: Checklist change -> Finding sync -> Action plan sync -> Score recalc -> findings_count update -> report_stale=true
implementation_details.action_plan_source_item_id: Action plans have source_item_id field linking to checklist items
implementation_details.findings_count_logic: Only counts findings where status != resolved_by_compliance
